description: Market Census's current score (0-100) and label for a single US ticker, or, when it does not rank one, that it is not ranked and why. It does not return a price or a daily move. Use when asked what Market Census says about a specific stock. Pass the exact US ticker symbol.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B

name: get_ticker_score
title: Get a ticker's Market Census score
